title: Correct part (1) answer
description: Essential: Student must provide the gravitational force for the complete sphere as F₁ = GMm/(4R²).

title: Correct part (2) answer
description: Essential: Student must provide the final net force for the excavated sphere as F = 7GMm/(36R²).

title: Mass of removed sphere
description: Important: Student must correctly calculate the mass of the small sphere as M' = M/8 using volume ratios.

title: Superposition principle application
description: Important: Student must subtract the force from the removed sphere from the original force to find the net force.

title: Distance for removed sphere
description: Important: Student must use the correct center-to-center distance (3R/2) between the small sphere and point mass.

title: Incorrect distance usage
description: Pitfall: Using 2R instead of 3R/2 for the distance to the center of the removed sphere.

title: Density consistency
description: Optional: Explicitly calculating or stating constant density to relate masses through volume ratios.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Adding instead of subtracting forces, or misrepresenting the vector nature of the superposition.
